title: Editor E1, slice 3: the design blocks and the three email cards join the contract
detail: Adopts photoHero, editorial, cardGrid, zigzag, accentBeat, displayHeading and prose (drawn through DesignBlockView) and the email-only productCard, eventCard and circleCard (live reads, resolved at send, one shared web card) into lib/entity-blocks/contract/. check:blocks now holds 23 of 41. Left on PROG-E1: the 18 data blocks and the binding layer.

verify.note: Fails when an adopted block stops holding the contract.
